detours.why: The Rhodes Animal Science Center complex lies on the straight line with no mapped path through it, so the walk goes round it.
Building 2266 is still a construction site in OSM (way/1490812995) with no mapped path out its north side, so the walk leaves to the south and comes round.
Buildings and service yards fill the block on the straight line with no mapped path through, so walks go round by the streets.
